# forms.toml: forms: what a field asks for, what it stands on, and what an answer does
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== a field goes in as it was answered
--- en_US
field: "Hi Dana,\nthanks.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\nthanks."
undo: 16 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi Dana,\nthanks.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\nthanks."
undo: 16 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi Dana,\nthanks.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\nthanks."
undo: 16 backspaces

=== a field nobody answered stands on its default
--- en_US
field: "Hi friend,|"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: 10 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi friend,|"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: 10 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi friend,|"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: 10 backspaces

=== a field with no default and no answer inserts nothing
--- en_US
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces

=== one name twice is one field and one answer
--- en_US
field: "Dana, it is Dana again|"
preview: ", it is  again"
undo: 22 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Dana, it is Dana again|"
preview: ", it is  again"
undo: 22 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Dana, it is Dana again|"
preview: ", it is  again"
undo: 22 backspaces

=== a field with room to write in takes an answer with line breaks
--- en_US
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.\nAsked for the log.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 43 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.\nAsked for the log.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 43 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.\nAsked for the log.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 43 backspaces

=== a height Aralo cannot read is left out, and the box is one line
--- en_US
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 24 backspaces
note: "Aralo cannot read the lines option here, so it is left out."
--- de_DE
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 24 backspaces
note: "Aralo cannot read the lines option here, so it is left out."
--- ja_JP
field: "Case notes:\nCalled back.|"
preview: "Case notes:\n"
undo: 24 backspaces
note: "Aralo cannot read the lines option here, so it is left out."

=== a drop-down stands on its first option
--- en_US
field: "Ships by post.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 14 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Ships by post.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 14 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Ships by post.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 14 backspaces

=== a drop-down with a default stands on the default
--- en_US
field: "Ships by courier.|"
preview: "Ships by courier."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Ships by courier.|"
preview: "Ships by courier."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Ships by courier.|"
preview: "Ships by courier."
undo: 17 backspaces

=== an answer the drop-down did not offer is still the answer
--- en_US
field: "Ships by by hand.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Ships by by hand.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Ships by by hand.|"
preview: "Ships by post."
undo: 17 backspaces

=== a drop-down with nothing to choose from says so
--- en_US
field: "Ships by .|"
preview: "Ships by ."
undo: 10 backspaces
error: "speed has nothing to choose from. Write | options: a, b, c."
--- de_DE
field: "Ships by .|"
preview: "Ships by ."
undo: 10 backspaces
error: "speed has nothing to choose from. Write | options: a, b, c."
--- ja_JP
field: "Ships by .|"
preview: "Ships by ."
undo: 10 backspaces
error: "speed has nothing to choose from. Write | options: a, b, c."

=== a field with no name cannot be answered
--- en_US
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces
error: "Write {{field: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."
--- de_DE
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces
error: "Write {{field: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi !|"
preview: "Hi !"
undo: 4 backspaces
error: "Write {{field: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."

=== the form and the clipboard are answered in that order
--- en_US
field: "Hi Dana, about PO-8841.|"
preview: "Hi , about {{clipboard}}."
undo: 23 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi Dana, about PO-8841.|"
preview: "Hi , about {{clipboard}}."
undo: 23 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi Dana, about PO-8841.|"
preview: "Hi , about {{clipboard}}."
undo: 23 backspaces

=== the case the abbreviation was typed in re-cases the answer
--- en_US
field: "Hi dana, and March |"
preview: "hi , and March"
undo: 19 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi dana, and März |"
preview: "hi , and März"
undo: 18 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi dana, and 3月 |"
preview: "hi , and 3月"
undo: 16 backspaces

=== an abbreviation typed in capitals shouts the whole expansion
--- en_US
field: "HI DANA, AND MARCH |"
preview: "hi , and March"
undo: 19 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "HI DANA, AND MÄRZ |"
preview: "hi , and März"
undo: 18 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "HI DANA, AND 3月 |"
preview: "hi , and 3月"
undo: 16 backspaces

=== a form the user escapes inserts nothing and keeps what was typed
--- en_US
field: ";x |"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: nothing was inserted
--- de_DE
field: ";x |"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: nothing was inserted
--- ja_JP
field: ";x |"
preview: "Hi friend,"
undo: nothing was inserted
